score_is: P(not beans), mean over patches; refuse when score > threshold

threshold_override.why: The calibrated 0.0459 refused 4/22 genuine holdout photos (3 of them internet-framed). 0.5 is the probe's own decision boundary (P(not beans) > P(beans)), not a value tuned to the holdout scores. Raising the threshold can only lower false refusals, so the certified alpha <= 4.3% remains a valid (now conservative) upper bound.
threshold_override.evidence_at_0.5: dev: 0/34 genuine refused, 82/82 negatives caught; holdout: 0/22 genuine refused, 56/56 negatives caught. Lowest negative score anywhere 0.9998.
threshold_override.caveat: The holdout informed this choice, so it no longer gives an unbiased estimate of the guard at 0.5. The negative-side margin (every negative >= 0.9998) is what the choice rests on. Photos in (1.7e-5, 0.5] get the warning note, not a refusal.
